# Local patches

This is the crates.io `icu_collator` 2.0.0 source package. Its upstream archive SHA-256, also recorded as the Cargo.lock checksum, is `42ad4c6a556938dfd31f75a8c54141079e8821dc697ffb799cfe0f0fa11f2edc`. The upstream `Cargo.toml.orig` and `LICENSE` are retained.

The local changes in `src/elements.rs` and `src/comparison.rs` repair Hangul/Jamo collation with search tailorings. Jamo first resolves through the active tailoring trie, then falls back to the shared root Jamo table. Precomposed Hangul syllables are decomposed into canonical L/V/T components in normal iteration and contraction lookahead. For a tailored comparison with Jamo or Hangul in the shared prefix or at its boundary, comparison starts from the original input iterators. This preserves contextual mappings and linear traversal without buffering the common prefix.

For the pinned ICU export tag `icu4x/2025-05-01/77.x`, generator source revision [`594c9b890abfa794a259162f1a29513445365f89`](https://github.com/unicode-org/icu/commit/594c9b890abfa794a259162f1a29513445365f89) needs a `genrb` change: preserve Jamo ranges in search-tailoring tries instead of exporting them as fallback entries. Without those locale CE32s, the tailored-trie lookup cannot see search mappings. Regenerating with this change alters only 44 search-trie TOML files; all other fields and non-data bytes match the pinned export. The export-pipeline change is maintained with the generated data pipeline, not in this vendored crate. Related upstream work: [ICU4X issue 1941](https://github.com/unicode-org/icu4x/issues/1941).
